top_issues.issue: Placeholder text fails WCAG 1.4.3 in light mode in every input (composer, filter, search, status, setup)
top_issues.evidence: composer/search placeholder #767779 on #ffffff = 4.48:1; filter/status/setup placeholder #727376 on #f6f6f7 = 4.39:1 (dark passes at 5.45-6.0)
top_issues.fix: Use the secondary text colour #62656d for placeholders (5.83:1 on #fff, 5.40:1 on #f6f6f7), or darken the placeholder token to #6b6e75 or darker.

top_issues.issue: Failed send is shown only as a transient toast that covers the last message, sits off-centre, and has no Retry
top_issues.evidence: toast spans x 374-905 (centre 640) while the conversation pane centre is 822; it overlays the 10:20 message at y=640-690; no Retry button and no failed marker on any message
top_issues.fix: Mark the failed message inline (red 'Not sent' label + Retry and Delete text buttons under it, 12 pt). If a toast stays, centre it on the pane, place it 12 px above the composer, add a 'Retry' button, and give it a 480 px max width so the text fits one line.

top_issues.issue: Settings checkboxes look like radio buttons and the unchecked state fails 3:1
top_issues.evidence: unchecked control is a 13 px circle #8e9199 on #eeeef0 = 2.72:1 (dark #6c6e77 on #2c2d33 = 2.70:1)
top_issues.fix: Draw square 16 px checkboxes with 3 px corner radius, 1.5 px border #8a8d95 light / #7c7f88 dark (>=3:1), checked state filled accent #a9530f / #e88c3e with a white/dark check.

top_issues.issue: Call bar contradicts the chat and wastes space
top_issues.evidence: bar reads 'In the meeting · just joined' while the timeline shows 'Meeting ended: 58 min · 09:35'; 34 px gap between title (y=24) and status (y=58); title truncates to 'Design review:...' at 380 px with ~150 px free; primary orange action is 'Done'
top_issues.fix: Put status on the line under the title with 4 px gap; truncate only when the text exceeds the available width; label the primary action 'Leave' or 'Back to Wren' with a neutral style; hide or reconcile 'Meeting ended' while a call is active.

top_issues.issue: Hover action toolbar covers message author lines and reactions
top_issues.evidence: chats-narrow toolbar y=268-303 sits over 'Alex Rivera 07:43' and the heart chip; channel-narrow covers 'Hedy Lamarr 09:54'; group-chat toolbar straddles two rows
top_issues.fix: Anchor the toolbar to the top-right of the hovered row at y = row_top - 16 px but clamp so it never overlaps the row's header text; at widths < 900 px show a single '...' button that opens the actions.

top_issues.issue: Hyphens render with wide gaps across the app
top_issues.evidence: 'On - call', 'full - text', 'go/no - go', 'Ad - hoc', 'open - source', 'Sign - in', 'F4KQ - 9TZW' all show ~4 px space on both sides of the hyphen
top_issues.fix: Render the normal U+002D hyphen from the UI font (not U+2011 or a fallback glyph); if non-breaking behaviour is needed, use U+2011 only where the UI font has that glyph.

top_issues.issue: Inputs lack a visible boundary and focus state
top_issues.evidence: composer border #dfdfe3 on #ffffff = 1.33:1, dark #303137 on #17181b = 1.37:1; no focus ring on the 'focused' long draft or the typing composer
top_issues.fix: Composer border #8a8d95 light / #6e7179 dark (>=3:1, matching the filter field), and a 2 px focus ring in accent #a9530f / #e88c3e on focus.

top_issues.issue: Long draft clips the top line and has no scroll affordance
top_issues.evidence: top draft line cut at y=552-560 against the composer edge; no inner scrollbar; attach/send centred at y=658 in a 210 px tall box
top_issues.fix: Give the text area 10 px inner top/bottom padding, show a thin scrollbar when content overflows, cap height at 40% of the pane, and pin the attach/send icons to the bottom-right (12 px inset).

top_issues.issue: Narrow windows keep the full 300 px sidebar
top_issues.evidence: at 760 px wide the sidebar occupies x 64-364, leaving 396 px for content; messages wrap to 3-4 short lines, composer placeholder and hint row wrap
top_issues.fix: Below 900 px, shrink the sidebar to 240 px; below 720 px collapse it to an overlay; hide the formatting hint row below 600 px of pane width.

top_issues.issue: No maximum reading width on wide windows
top_issues.evidence: at 1920 wide, message lines reach ~800 px and the composer is 1520 px wide
top_issues.fix: Constrain message column and composer to max 760-800 px (about 90 characters at 14 pt), left aligned after the avatar column, or centred in the pane.

top_issues.issue: Disabled primary buttons are illegible and look broken; input/button heights don't match
top_issues.evidence: calls disabled Join #e8d2c1 on #d0a583 = 1.54:1 (dark 1.81:1); setup Save 1.51:1 / 1.86:1; calls input 29 px tall vs Join 34 px
top_issues.fix: Disabled buttons: neutral fill #eeeef0 / #2c2d33 with #8a8d95 text (keeps the shape recognisable). Make inputs and adjacent buttons the same 32 px height and vertically centre them.

top_issues.issue: Presence states are indistinguishable by shape, and away/unread colours collide
top_issues.evidence: Busy and DND both red dots (#c42b2b), BRB and Away both #8a5a00; light away #8a5a00 vs unread dot #a9530f are near-identical browns
top_issues.fix: Use distinct glyphs: DND = red dot with white bar, Away/BRB = amber dot with clock cut-out, Offline = hollow ring. Shift light away to #b7791f (amber) so it differs from the orange unread accent.

top_issues.issue: Account menu items are not on a common left edge
top_issues.evidence: '+ Add account' and 'Settings...' text at x=63, status dots at x=79 with text at x=95, checkbox icon at x=70 with text at x=85
top_issues.fix: Use one 16 px icon column at x=72 and one text column at x=96 for every row; give 'Add account' a plus icon and 'Settings' a gear icon; replace the empty checkbox with a speech-bubble icon.

top_issues.issue: Conversation header has no divider; content clips under it
top_issues.evidence: pixels at x=700, y=40-61 are all #ffffff; partial avatar and name of the first message are cut at y=44-60
top_issues.fix: Add a 1 px bottom border #e4e4e8 / #2c2d33 under the 56 px header, or a 12 px fade from the page colour.

top_issues.issue: Primary and secondary buttons differ in height
top_issues.evidence: signin primary y=382-415 (34 px) vs secondary 383-414 (32 px); status Save 34 px vs Clear 30 px
top_issues.fix: Use one 32 px button height for all variants; differentiate by fill only.

top_issues.issue: Calendar and Calls detail panes have no header bar, unlike chat and channel panes
top_issues.evidence: chat panes have a 56 px header with title and actions; calendar title floats at y=78 with an empty band above
top_issues.fix: Use the same 56 px header (title 15 pt bold, subtitle 12 pt) with Join and Copy link as header actions.

top_issues.issue: Dark dialogs barely separate from the scrim
top_issues.evidence: switcher panel #25262b vs scrim #0a0a0c = 1.31:1, no border
top_issues.fix: Add a 1 px border #3a3b42 to dark dialogs and lighten the scrim to rgba(0,0,0,0.5) so the panel edge is crisp.

top_issues.issue: Pasted-image thumbnails crop content and remove buttons overlap corners
top_issues.evidence: first and third thumbnails show cut birds; x buttons at the top-right corner overlap the image
top_issues.fix: Use object-fit contain on a #eeeef0 / #2c2d33 tile, 96x72 px, with the remove button 6 px inset on a white/dark ring.
